verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Bruno has an environment selector with search filtering, drag-and-drop variable management, and CLI overrides via --global-env-var, all indicating a working environment/variable-set system for switching contexts. However, no evidence explicitly documents a dev/staging/prod workflow or environment creation/management UI in depth. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating and switching between multiple named environments (e.g. dev/staging/prod), and independent hands-on confirmation of environment-switching UX.
